source.pc: In this skill you learn to move a factor to the other side of an equation. If you have an equation like you will be able to bring to the other side to get , or to then bring to the other side to get . This includes understanding the idea behind this: multiplying both sides of an equation by a factor and subsequently canceling fraction factors. The skill does not include dealing with equations with multiple terms.

target.pc: In dieser Kompetenz lernst du, einen Faktor auf die andere Seite der Gleichung zu bringen. source.pc: A product equation is an equation like where both sides of the equation only have multiplications and divisions; no additions or subtractions. When we have such an equation, it is helpful to be able to move factors around in the equation. That's what this skill is about. We look at how we do this, and what short-cuts we can take.

target.pc: Eine Produktgleichung ist eine Gleichung wie , bei der beide Seiten der Gleichung nur Multiplikationen/Divisionen enthalten; keine Additionen oder Subtraktionen. In einer solchen Gleichung ist es nützlich, Faktoren zwischen den beiden Seiten der Gleichung verschieben zu können. Darum geht es in dieser Kompetenz. Wir schauen uns an, wie das funktioniert und welche Abkürzungen wir möglicherweise nehmen können.

source.pc: We can summarize the above ideas into a useful short-cut. If we move a factor (multiplication or division) from one side of a product equation to the other, we should do the following.

pc.pc: If the factor is a multiplication factor (it's in the numerator of a fraction, or just in a multiplication) then on the other side it will appear as a division factor (in the denominator of a fraction). So turns into .

If the factor is a division factor (in the denominator of a fraction) then on the other side it will appear as a multiplication factor (in the numerator of a fraction, or just in a multiplication). So turns into .

source.pc: Using this idea, we can also directly move factors around, without applying the in-between steps.
